findings.name: Concrete reflected account vtable
findings.evidence: UFortOnlineAccount reflection GPSC 0x142a07490 registers /Script/FortniteGame FortOnlineAccount, size 0x858, with constructor wrapper 0x142a07a00. The wrapper loads the constructed object and jumps to constructor 0x142202590, which calls 0x1410be350 then stores vtable 0x1460e2a68 at object+0. The mapped image qword at 0x1460e2d58 (vtable+0x2f0) is 0x142233030. This identifies the dispatch for an actual UFortOnlineAccount instance; the concrete runtime class of the account resolved by the sign-in interaction has not independently been verified.

findings.name: Fortnite StartLogin override
findings.evidence: 0x142233030 sets account+0x738 to zero. It calls 0x1409f0710 and tests 0x1442f92d0; on the false branch it retrieves an object via 0x1442f3c00, performs a class test and calls 0x141e613c0. When the resulting object exists and its byte +0x118 is nonzero, it logs that P1 matchmaking is being cancelled before P2 login and calls 0x1421cb250(object,3). It then unconditionally tail-calls 0x1410e6b40. Names beyond the logged intent and offsets are unproven.

findings.name: Common state-machine initiation
findings.evidence: 0x1410e6b40 logs UOnlineAccountCommon::StartLogin, copies the eight-byte global at 0x1480e8a38 into account+0x338, then tail-calls 0x1410c3c30(account, global). 0x1410c3c30 first calls account virtual +0x150 and returns if it is null. Otherwise it builds an allocated 0x30-byte weak-object callback capturing the account and supplied state, clones the delegate, calls 0x1410cefe0(account), and passes its result and the callback to 0x144627d90, before delegate cleanup. This records scheduling/dispatch structure, not successful execution or completion.

unresolved: Confirm the resolved runtime account class and possible subclass overrides, concrete initialization and successful identity/backend completion. The registered next-tick callback and ContinueLoggingIn dispatcher are identified in state_callback_followup; execution, concrete initialization path, virtual state-change effects and waiting-room completion remain unverified. Existing local account HTTP/profile selection does not establish original successful login bootstrap; do not replace missing effects with a state flip, broadcast or frontend travel.
verification: Read-only Ghidra decompilation and instruction inspection, constructor wrapper disassembly, plus original mapped-image vtable qword read. Ghidra project bookkeeping changed; program not saved. No builds or runtime login test.
